description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of 'git check-ignore'. It contains numerous test cases, setup routines, and utility functions to validate ignore rules including handling of symlinks, submodules, global ignore files, and various command-line options. It is not a typical source code file defining classes or methods but rather a test script for the git version control system.

methods.name: init_vars
methods.description: Initializes variables related to global excludes.

methods.name: enable_global_excludes
methods.description: Enables global exclude file for git.

methods.name: expect_in
methods.description: Outputs expected text into a specified destination file, used for testing.

methods.name: test_stderr
methods.description: Checks if the stderr contains a specific pattern.

methods.name: stderr_contains
methods.description: Verifies if the stderr includes a regex pattern.

methods.name: stderr_empty_on_success
methods.description: Checks if stderr is empty on success, or allows error output on failure.

methods.name: test_check_ignore
methods.description: Runs the 'git check-ignore' command with parameters and verifies the exit code and output.
